args.description: tips slowly backwards off balance and sinks down until he lies flat on his back on the floor, a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins lying flat on the floor beside him, still in his hand, ending lying still; nothing else is drawn around him. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a huge jagged black greatsword with glowing red veins
